name: An Eye for an Eye
source:
After the monster's guild takes down a beholder, one of the members takes one of its eyes to replace the one they lost.

[From [url=https://plagueofcrows.itch.io/an-eye-for-an-eye]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
怪物公会消灭了一名眼魔后，其中一名成员取走了眼魔的一只眼睛来代替他们失去的那只眼睛。

[来自[url=https://plagueofcrows.itch.io/an-eye-for-an-eye]itch.io[/url]]
